name: Tenafly
summary: Cases of Tenafly, a black private eye working in L.A.

name: Aussie Shore
summary: Aussie Shore follows the wild antics of a group of young and rowdy housemates as they work hard, and party even harder whilst navigating the highs and lows of living together 24/7 in the non-stop party town of Cairns.

name: Todome no Parallel
summary: Todome no Kiss spin-off showing what would happen if Otaro wouldn't be able to go back in time with a kiss and be revived? A real world like parallel timeline about what happens after Otaro's deaths.

name: Chloe Chronicles Smallville
summary: Chloe Sullivan goes on with her research on extended stories of her Wall of Weird findings.

previousepisode.name: A New Kinda Loft Scene (Vengeance Chronicles)

name: Солнце, море, два ствола
summary: Policeman Gosha Adamyan wants to head the operational department in Sochi. An enterprising guy has every chance to get a position: he easily copes with any business, using numerous contacts at the resort. But everything changes when Captain Vorontsov from Moscow appears in the department. Adamyan's sister Diana, an aspiring journalist, likes a principled man, but also Kira, the daughter of the head of the local Department of Internal Affairs, whom Gosha is in love with. And now both Adamyan's promotion and his personal life are under threat.

name: Max & the Midknights
summary: Max & the Midknights follows a determined 10-year-old girl named Max, who pursues her dream of becoming a knight by leading her friends on an epic adventure in the fantastical medieval kingdom of Byjovia.

name: Dateline: The Smoking Gun
summary: Hosted by "Dateline's" Andrea Canning, "Dateline: The Smoking Gun" is a hunt for clues as detectives relentlessly pursue the critical piece of evidence that ultimately cracks the case. Each investigation is packed with twists — false leads, wrong suspects, dead ends — until police finally uncover the smoking gun and arrive at justice. Stories investigated this season include a disappearance involving a young film director, two prosecutors killed in a small Texas town and a serial killer who must be stopped before the next victim is murdered.

name: Yolngu Radio's Festival Sessions
summary: Yolngu Radio have joined in partnership with Arnhem Land Progress Aboriginal Corporation to deliver 5 festivals in each major community in North East Arnhem Land to showcase music, dance and culture.

name: Pacific Island Food Revolution
summary: Pacific Island Food Revolution is an innovative program that promotes local, healthy food in the Pacific to combat the non-communicable disease crisis through communications and partnerships.

name: Elizabeth Taylor: Rebel Superstar
summary:
For too long the story of Elizabeth Taylor has been told as a soap opera. The eight marriages, the diamonds, the addictions. This series gives Elizabeth Taylor the significance she richly deserves, in all her incarnations: as an actor, rebel, business mogul, and activist – to reveal how Taylor created the blueprint for modern celebrity.

The series will take a deep dive into Taylor's craft and technique as an actor – one who mesmerised cinemagoers, but also changed the relationship between audiences and stars. We'll see how she reinvented the nature of fame, even as she smashed the glass ceiling in Hollywood, before going on to become a billion-dollar businesswoman, activist and advocate.

We'll draw on never-before-heard audio tapes, interviews, and unseen TV footage, alongside rich archive of her movies. The series will also feature interviews with a range of high-profile stars who knew Taylor personally - including Kim Kardashian, who conducted the last interview with her before she died, Dame Joan Collins, a friend and Hollywood contemporary who competed with Elizabeth for the role of Cleopatra, Margaret O'Brien, who went to school with her on the MGM backlot, close friend Carole Bayer Sager, leading scientist Dr. Anthony Fauci who worked alongside Elizabeth in the fight against AIDS, and others. Each has a unique insight into a different aspect of Taylor's story.

This definitive three-part series will reveal the life and times of a superstar who transformed not just Hollywood but fame itself, as she went from child star to highest-paid actress in the world.

Each episode will examine how she broke down barriers in every part of her life – and the price she paid for defying convention.

name: Umizaru
summary:
Coast Guard officer Senzaki Daisuke is in training to become a rescue diver. His course completed, he's ready for his first assignment on board an aging rescue vessel. The ship's captain is due to retire soon and the head diver refuses to offer Daisuke any guidance. To add to his woes, his girlfriend doesn't seem to be too happy to see him, despite their maintaining a long-distance relationship via the phone.

The manga adaptation consists of this TV series and four films. This is continuation on the movie with the same name released a year earlier, and is followed by more movies afterwards.

name: Super Shark Highway
summary: Infiltrate the secret migration routes of sharks along Australia's coasts. Dive in with elite scientific teams as they study their mysterious movements, witness elusive behaviours, and determine how humans can coexist with these incredible creatures.

name: Hitler's British Island
summary:
Alderney, a tiny island in the English Channel, is the site of one of the darkest and most mysterious chapters in World War II. Given the sinister codename 'Adolf Island', Alderney became a preoccupation for Hitler and was transformed into one of the most heavily fortified places on earth. Away from prying eyes, the Nazis also established a concentration camp, the only one on British soil, amid the idyllic scenery of woodlands and silver sand beaches. But how many people were murdered there and why were the Nazi killers never brought to justice?

Over two 60-minute episodes, Hitler's British Island will reveal the startling death toll - far in excess of the number recorded by wartime investigators. And following painstaking research by expert historians, the show will reveal how Nazi war criminals were allowed to go free, with the reason covered up for 80 years.

name: The Chocolate Queen
summary: Pastry chef and chocolatier Kirsten Tibballs provides a number of handy tips and tricks for superior home baking.

name: Ángel Di María: Romper la pared
summary: From his humble origins to becoming champion of the world, this documentary series recounts the life and career of the iconic Argentinian soccer player.

name: Into the Fire: The Lost Daughter
summary: In this riveting true-crime documentary, a determined mother partners with an amateur sleuth to solve the mystery of her birth daughter's disappearance.

name: All Fired Up
summary: Chef Nico Reynolds shares recipes for mouth-watering barbecue dishes.

name: The Troubleshooters
summary: Adventures of a Construction Gang on difficult jobs.

name: Bad Days
summary: Even heroes wake up on the wrong side of the bed. This show features our greatest heroes and their greatest failures.

name: You Bet! On Tour
summary:
It's still the show where ordinary people take on extraordinary challenges but this time we're taking it on the road! Each episode will take place in a different iconic location around the country. Free from the restrictions of the studio - our epic challenges are about to get a whole lot bigger.

Watching on, the celebrity panel's job is simple; they must decide if each challenger will succeed - Yes or No. If they guess correctly, they'll be awarded points. The Celebrity with the most points at the end of the show will receive £5,000 for their chosen charity.

name: Prince William: We Can End Homelessness
summary:
With access to the Prince over 12 months, this landmark documentary will follow Prince William as he launches Homewards across the country and the journeys of those currently facing homelessness or who have lived experience of the issue.

This documentary will also feature well-known advocates of the programme alongside those leading individual projects across the UK - the Royal Foundation has described Homewards as ‘a five-year programme that aims to demonstrate that it's possible to end homelessness by working with six locations

name: Gotham Tonight
summary: Gotham Tonight was a talk show featuring guests from "The Dark Knight" leading up to the release of the 2008 film.

name: ATEEZ: The Curse of the Money Hole
summary: After getting their license back from ESC, ATEEZ, the space pirate group, receives a special mission to 'find the topping stone hidden in the pirate island' and shows the journey to the infamous pirate island.

name: Quanta guerra!
summary: In many families there are still unanswered questions and silences that have not been broken. For example, after the war, most men and women who lived through the conflict chose never to talk about it. While they kept quiet out of fear, prudence or forgetting, their children, during the dictatorship, learned not to ask. Now, however, the grandchildren's generation wants to know what happened and what their grandparents experienced between 1936 and 1939, when they were still young and had their whole lives ahead of them. This documentary series, with two seasons and eleven episodes in total, has journalist Eloi Vila as presenter and driving force behind the research of all the stories. With it, the famous guests travel to the past to discover the most personal stories of their ancestors.

name: Pysäyttäkää Nyqvist
summary: Aleksis Nyqvist, an intern at the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, is thrust into Finland's new secret service. Nyqvist accidentally provokes a political security crisis. Soon Helsinki will be swarming with secret agents.

name: Wäldern
summary: In the small town of Walden, young residents keep disappearing under mysterious circumstances. One of them is Magda, the niece of the pianist Lara Glanz. She returns to her old hometown and takes a job as a teacher. She also searches for Magda on her own, whose disappearance seems increasingly mysterious.

name: Little Miss Innocent: Passion. Poison. Prison.
summary:
Little Miss Innocent: Passion. Poison. Prison., a chilling three-part docuseries that tells the story of Kaitlyn Conley, a 31-year-old former receptionist who claims she has been wrongfully convicted of the 2015 killing of Mary Yoder, her former boss and the mother of her ex-boyfriend Adam. Known as a polite young woman in her town of Sauquoit, New York, Conley's conviction sent shockwaves through the local community, dividing the town about what and who to believe.

For the first time since her sentencing, convicted killer Kaitlyn Conley speaks out, staunchly maintaining her innocence, detailing her toxic relationship with Adam and offering her theories on who killed Mary and why. The docuseries also features never-before-seen police interviews, exclusive audio recordings of the victim on the day she was poisoned, and a never-before-heard audio interview with the victim's husband, Bill Yoder. With unrivaled access to friends, families, investigators, local press and townsfolk, this docuseries is the first time in seven years the Yoder family has gone public and the first time since their daughter's conviction that Kaitlyn's parents have spoken out.

name: iOS Today
summary: Join Rosemary Orchard and Mikah Sargent for iOS Today, TWiT.tv's podcast for all things iPhone, iPad, Apple Watch, Apple TV, and more! From app reviews to helpful tips and tricks, from the latest news to the coolest accessories, Rosemary and Mikah will help you make the most of all your iOS devices.

name: Thumblite
summary: Thumblite is set in Silicon Valley and examines the schemes, rivalries, visions and obsessions of the power brokers and their underlings as they vie for control of the most powerful industry the world has ever known.

name: Наследники. Дар крови
summary: The daughter of the great magician Nadia commits an attack on a strictly guarded repository of artifacts. Stealing her father's ring, which can protect her family, fails, and Nadia disappears. And now her husband Roman, a surgeon from the human world, has to raise three children himself. Years later, teenagers suddenly discover superpowers in themselves, which magicians, including Vera, a tough operative in the Magical Security Department, find out about. The life of the family ceases to be the same, because the grandchildren of the legendary magician have been seriously hunted.

name: The Secret of Male Students
summary: Ji Won has the ability to read other peoples minds. However, when he encounters Si Woo, he discovers that Si Woo is the one person whose thoughts remain a mystery to him.

name: Mozart: Rise of a Genius
summary: Child prodigy, flawed human, musical giant. Letters, manuscripts and performances reveal the making of a man who created some of the world's most magnificent music.

name: Dennis the Menace
summary:
The Beano's Dennis the Menace and his trusty canine side-kick Gnasher in the first animated adventures.

The classic family sit-com format sees comic prankster Dennis outwit arch rivals Walter and Matilda every week, and always ready with a comedy custard pie in the face of authority – including his long-suffering parents, neighbour The Colonel and Beanotown's policeman, Sgt Slipper.

name: El caso Sancho
summary: Scrutinizes the events around Spaniard Daniel Sancho, eldest son of actor Rodolfo Sancho, sentenced to life in prison by Thai courts for the murder of Colombian citizen Edwin Arrieta.

name: Paddy and Chris: Road Tripping
summary:
Paddy and Chris: Road Tripping sees the duo head to Europe, to look at how our European neighbours grow old gracefully and make their years ahead their best yet.

The series will see self-proclaimed "well and truly middle aged" Paddy and ‘'soon to be fifty'' Chris go on a mission to explore the secrets to living a long and full life. The two friends will be meeting some of the healthiest, happiest, not to mention ‘well -preserved' and long-lived people alive. Along the way, they will be getting under the skin of each country they visit as well as doing plenty of soul searching.

The pair will head to Sweden, Greece and Switzerland. Facing classic midlife tropes of their own, Paddy and Chris will take a deep dive to discover some of the most brilliant mid-life secrets on the planet.

name: Amazon Music Live
summary: Amazon Music Live is a new concert series hosted by hip-hop royalty, 2 Chainz. Kicking off every week after Thursday Night Football, the shows will feature live, first-time performances from some of today's hottest artists.

name: Чудо
summary: Police Lieutenant Dan Orlov accidentally knocks down a colleague with a car who was supposed to infiltrate the Miracle Alcoholics Anonymous group. Now the responsibility falls on his shoulders, because the meetings of the "Chudo" are supervised by former criminal boss Vasily Sapogov. In the 90s, his gang stole the cup of the Russian tsar of the Time of Troubles Vasily Shuisky from the museum of the city of Electrospas, where his fake was later "triumphantly returned". Almost no one knows about this, but an important exhibition is about to take place, and Dan has been instructed to return the original at all costs.

name: Либидо
summary: Heartbreaker Anfisa, intellectual Sofia and mother of many children Milena founded an agency to expose unfaithful husbands. Bringing men to clean water, manipulating and seducing is their profession. Another order comes in: the oligarch's wife asks to find evidence of her husband Dmitry's infidelity, and in return promises to give half of his company after the divorce. The seduction mission is successful, but unexpectedly the woman forgives her husband and tells him everything. The oligarch is furious. His goal is to destroy the impudent avengers, because of whom he almost lost his fortune.

name: Нам кранты
summary: Three teenagers get their hands on gas cutting equipment. Deciding to earn some extra money, the boys take the car of a police officer neighbor and go to an abandoned construction site to cut up and sell an old tower crane for scrap metal. But here's the problem: the crane falls on the car of the leader of a criminal group. And now what seemed like a profitable business becomes the beginning of a whole series of problems.

name: The Godfather of Fentanyl
summary: 'The Godfather of Fentanyl' tells the story of the first widespread fentanyl overdose epidemic in US history, featuring exclusive interviews with George Erik Marquardt. A self-taught savant, Marquardt teams up with the Boston mob to introduce fentanyl in the early 90's. His product quickly finds its way to cities all over the Northeast and results in a national priority investigation by the DEA. Told by Marquardt and law enforcement officials who chased him, this is a never-before-heard story.

name: Feebs
summary: Feebs is an ensemble character-driven comedy following two sisters who love and hate each other and are thrown together as agents for the FBI. With their sibling rivalry on display in front of their teammates, the two must use their lifelong contention to fight for justice and not just with each other.

name: The Long Chase
summary: Tom Corby and his son John are bird watching, by the cliffs, when he spots a number of strangers. John goes to help a girl cut off from land. When he returns his dad has vanished.

name: Fourever You
summary: Easter, who attends university in the north of Thailand, hopes to find a new place to erase the memories about his ex-relationship which ended unclearly. But who would think that in this university he will meet Hill, his ex, again. It is the beginning of the relationship that will not be ending in the same way ever. At the same time his roommate North, also faces the chaos because he was drunk and caused a quarrel. But it could be more chaotic because god just sent him a flirtatious and very spoiled creditor Johan. So, the stories of these roommates have begun among the laughter of the friends from Art club like Typhoon and Dao-Tok. Also with the senior medical students Tonfah and Arthit. Their friendship in this university and the love stories will be their memorable notes for a long time.

previousepisode.name: Special The Sun From Another Star

name: Last Lands
summary: ABC News Live, the 24/7 streaming news channel, is partnering with Global Conservation, the only international nonprofit organization focused on the direct protection of endangered national parks and Indigenous territories in developing countries, to present Last Lands, a gripping new series spotlighting the global fight to protect our planet's most threatened ecosystems.

name: Murder in the Village: Who Killed the Doctor's Wife?
summary: An award-winning team of documentary makers revisit one of Britain's most baffling cold cases - the murder forty years ago of Diane Jones, the 35 year old wife of the doctor serving the picturesque Essex town of Coggeshall.

name: Весна моего сердца
summary: Olga Lemesheva, a sweet, kind girl, lives in a small apartment with her mother. The family runs a small business, a cozy café. But the profits from the business are mere pennies, and the family is constantly short of money. Recently, her mother has become increasingly alcoholic, and her daughter's health has deteriorated significantly. The problem is that Olga has a congenital heart defect. Her condition is currently dire, and doctors offer no guarantee. She needs a donor heart transplant, but she has neither a donor nor the money for the operation.

name: Tiny Toot
summary: Tiny Toot is about 3 years old. She lives with her cat Gato, her brother, and her mum and dad ... and then there's Pixie, her magic making the elf who lives in a mouse hole in the wall. Every morning Pixie invites Tiny Toot and Gato on a new adventure. They eagerly join him in his nut-chopper and together they make friends with everyone they meet and learn new things about daily day life.

name: Sinn Féin Ard Fheis
summary: Live coverage of the Sinn Féin Ard Fheis.

previousepisode.name: Sinn Féin Ard Fheis: The Leader's Speech with ISL

name: Nicola Benedetti Presents Up Late in Edinburgh
summary: Filmed late and live with an audience at the Edinburgh International Festival Hub, Sky Arts will air two 90 minute specials on classical and Jazz music, with violin virtuoso Nicola Benedetti introducing and playing in both shows alongside 9 times Grammy awarded winning jazz musician Wynton Marsalis. This is a unique opportunity to see these world class performers together in one room and captured as live for Sky Arts.

name: Kabát FC
summary: Hungarian reality show starring Péter Kabát, a former professional footballer.

name: My Man's Man
summary: College sweethearts Gina and Minwoo, are always with Minwoo's friend, Wan, who might have feelings for Minwoo.

name: Quel talent!
summary: Local talents come to show us what they are capable of and will try to win the hearts of the public as well as those of the judges.

previousepisode.name: QUEL TALENT!, un an plus tard

name: Rule #1: No Dating
summary: Rookie idol group Deep Blue faces a crisis amid leader Jeongwoo and Junhee's secret romance and conflicts with Alex.

name: Falling for my BOSS
summary: Lee Joon, the owner of a flower shop, worries that his shop will be endangered by his in-house romance, but he is also confused by Eun-ho's presence that is deeply rooted in his heart.

name: Dear Parents
summary: Follows Liu Bi Yun and Jiang Tian Huai who became husband and wife in their second marriage. Each with children of their own, they not only face outside challenges in their career but also have to handle family members with very different personalities. They return to the city after ten years of separation. Liu Bi Yun's stepdaughter Jiang Mei and grandma are the instigators of many conflicts within the family but Liu Bi Yun never takes it to heart as she tries to be a good mother and a good influence.

name: Gizli Bahçe
summary: Nazlı is a young, poor, single mother living with her son, Memo. When Demir Akçınar, Memo's wealthy uncle, finds out about his nephew after his brother's death, he is determined to take Memo under his care. However, once he learns about Nazlı's profession, Demir refuses to let someone like her raise his nephew and begins a fierce custody battle. Nazlı, however, is not the woman Demir thinks she is. As Nazlı and Demir fight for Memo's future, long-buried secrets, family schemes, and shadows from the past complicate the struggle even further.

name: Grab Your Love
summary: It tells the story of Min Jiangxi, who aspires to become "the Number One Female tutor in Shencheng", and Qin Zhan, known as "the Villain in Shencheng". The two start off being wary of each other, but gradually develop deep affection and mutual understanding. In the end, they join forces as powerful partners to eliminate the great villains in the business world. While growing together and healing each other, they stage a passionate love affair in the upper-class world.

name: Sisters in Arms
summary: It tells the story of the "Hummer Commandos" from the Binjiang City SWAT team as they fight crime and protect the people. The "Hummer Commandos" are elite police officers with modern law enforcement skills and a strong sense of duty. They are compassionate and committed. Whether in the community, on the streets, during arrests, or on the front lines, their heroic and tireless efforts are everywhere. They are the embodiment of the "visible sense of security" that people can rely on.

name: Profilerka
summary: A macabre crime takes place in a forester's lodge near Augustów - the entire family is murdered, including a several-year-old boy. The investigation is led by commissioner Karol Nadzieja, transferred from the capital to Augustów. When the crime at the forester's lodge is finally solved and everyone breathes a sigh of relief, new victims appear. No one yet suspects that in this previously quiet neighborhood, where life was "like God's home," a sophisticated and cunning serial killer has just begun his "hunt." Fear falls on the city and its surroundings.

name: Wichita Town
summary: The exploits of Mike Dunbar, the marshal, and his attempts to maintain law and order in the growing town of Wichita, Kansas during the 1870's.

name: Pobail na Páirce
summary:
Pobail na Páirce, a four-part series for TG4, tells the stories of Ireland's most iconic and revered provincial GAA grounds. 

Spending a day in the life of historic stadiums across the four provinces of Ireland on their biggest matchdays of the year, this series reveals the incredible logistics required to make GAA matches happen, the history of these magnificent amphitheaters, and the importance of these places in our lives, today. 

Over four weeks Pobail na Páirce journeys across the country, pulling back the curtain on these homes of GAA to explore how these sports grounds are so much more than bricks and mortar; they have become the beating heart of our provinces. From the birthplace of GAA in Thurles' Semple Stadium for the Munster Hurling Final, to the historic site for women's sport in Navan's Páirc Tailteann as the Meath ladies football team clash with Dublin. And from the home of the Ulster Final in Clones' St Tiarnachs Park during the fierce Ulster Championship to the beating heart of Galway GAA in Pearse Stadium for the Senior Club Hurling Final.

name: The 2 Johnnies Do America
summary: The 2 Johnnies are one of Ireland's hottest rising entertainment acts from Co. Tipperary - they are Comedians, Musicians, Presenters (and former bad hurlers). The 2 Johnnies are on the up. With all the success, they have had in Ireland it's time for the lads to make their way in the world and now they embark of their first tour of America. This series follows them as they navigate their first US tour and look at the current state of Irishness in America from the multigenerational "Irish" to the recent arrivals, asking the question 'what is IRISH AMERICAN in Trump's America? The lads also get to meet some amazing Americans doing weird and wonderful things. So armed with a bunch of stories to tell, the lads head to LA, Miami, and Washington to perform their live podcast.

name: Söhne der Sonne
summary: The three-part documentary series examines the rise and fall of the ancient American empires of the Maya, Incas and Aztecs.

name: The Giants
summary: We follow the epic lives of sumo legends who made it from humble beginnings in Hawaii, to becoming the first foreigners to rise to the highest ranks in sumo.

name: Wild Pacific Rescue
summary: Explore the coast with a world-renowned marine vet and a skilled team of specialists as they rescue, rehabilitate, and release some of the most fascinating mammals on the planet, from tiny sea otter pups to 1,500-pound sea lions.

name: My Alibi
summary: Someone pulled a massive prank at Wheeler High School, and the prime suspects are confined to the suspension room until one confesses. Submit to a Take180.com challenge and a story from your life could become theirs.

name: Trump's Heist: The President Who Wouldn't Lose
summary: The astonishing inside story of how, in the wake of his 2020 election defeat, Donald Trump and his loyalists set out to engineer victory.

name: The Fated Magical Princess: Who Made Me a Princess
summary: In the magical kingdom, Princess Shia has unique gemstone eyes and discovers that her dreams seem to predict the future. On her eighteenth birthday, she gets caught in a huge conspiracy: her father almost dies from black magic, and she is exiled to a distant land. As Shia grows up, the key figures of her destiny start to appear: her reserved and stern father, a narcissistic and sharp-tongued magician, a loyal and devoted knight, the gentle and shy son of a duke, and a girl longing for family love. Can the brave and kind Shia change her fate and protect herself and all those she loves?

name: CUMASC: Séisiúin sa Black Gate
summary: CUMASC: Séisiúin sa Black Gate is a music series that blends gorgeous concert film with intimate observational documentary and interview. Over 12 episodes, a mix of emerging and established artists - both Irish and international - come together in celebration of collaboration and creativity. Immense musical talent. Diverse voices, old and new. Moments of connection, bold and true. CUMASC captures them all with an air of spontaneous energy and joy. Traditions and imaginations merge seamlessly, resulting in utterly captivating performances and stunning new music.

name: Asalto al Banco Central
summary: Spain, 1981: When armed men hold up a bank and take hundreds hostage, a reporter races against the authorities to uncover the true motive for the heist.

name: Противостояние
summary: Based on the novel of the same name by Yulian Simonov (author of Stierlitz from "Seventeen Moments of Spring"). A dismembered body is found in the forest in 1979 Magadan, eastern Soviet Russia. The way the body was cut and hidden seems similar to a similar event that happened years ago near the end of WW2-Europe.

name: A Walk in the Park
summary: Malik tha Martian is a climber and outdoorsman from the tough side of Memphis who is unafraid to call it as he sees it. Each episode features Malik and a guest taking a walk in a park, which means each episode features Malik and a guest on treadmills outdoors, discussing the topics of the day as the speeds and inclines of the treadmills constantly change.

previousepisode.name: Adeline Wright on Not Being Taken Advantage of by the Climbing Industry

name: EpicQuest
summary: A character and location driven docudrama anchored by the adventure travel company EpicQuest. The story driven series will follow the guides, athletes and operational heads of the company as they work their way through a season of guiding, hosting and fulfilling the lifelong dreams of clients.

name: Jeremy Jones' Deeper
summary: Jeremy Jones' Deeper, a 10 episode series from legendary snowboarder Jeremy Jones and TGR, will premiere exclusively on Outside Television February 22, 2011. The series will give viewers an intense look at the personalities, adventure, drama, and excitement from two years of filming Deeper, showcasing some of the greatest snowboarding adventures on the planet. Pushing the limits, Jones and the crew forego the use of fuel-powered machines and go deeper into the mountains using a simpler method - the human body.

name: Sisters-in-Law
summary: In Sisters-in-Law, two sisters-in-law who are struggling to get along finally bond together when they are faced with a common enemy: a new third sister-in-law.

name: Blood Legacy
summary: After years of estrangement, Khanyi Adesina returns home to fight for her family's business empire as it threatens to collapse under corruption.

name: Gourmet Farmer Afloat
summary: In Gourmet Farmer Afloat, Matthew Evans takes a break from the farm to head off on the adventure of a lifetime with his buddies Nick Haddow and Ross O'Meara, mapping out Tassie's rich food heritage. The guys are swapping their wellies for deck shoes and taking to the high seas to circumnavigate their island home in a wooden yacht. The boat is stocked with fishing rods, dive gear, barrels of whiskey and history books – all they need do is learn to sail!

name: Fort Boyard - Az erőd
summary: The Hungarian version of the French competition. In the show, teams of 5 people fight for the treasure of a lonely sea fortress, completing tasks that test both their physical and mental abilities.

name: Balamory
summary: In the Scottish island town of Balamory, a lovable community of quirky characters celebrate each day with rainbow-coloured comic adventures filled with songs, friendship and fun.

name: Tom et Lola
summary: Two close friends and fellow cops, Tom and Lola, end up living and working together after Tom's marriage breaks down, blending crime procedural with feel-good family elements.

name: Yo Yogi!
summary: Resourceful teens Yogi Bear, Boo-Boo Bear, Huckleberry Hound, Snagglepuss and Cindy Bear work as detectives in the local mall to thwart criminals, including the scheming Dickie Dastardly.

name: Douglas Edwards with the News
summary: On May 3, 1948, Edwards began anchoring CBS Television News, now a regular 15-minute nightly newscast on the CBS television network. It was the first regularly scheduled, network television news program featuring an anchor.

name: MTV faces
summary: MTV faces is the brand's short-form digital series that tackles important, under-discussed topics. After a successful debut focusing on grief, the upcoming series will be hosted by Jordan Stephens and address ADHD. Alongside celebrity guests such as Matt Willis, Cat Burns, Jessie Mei Lei, Wes Nelson and Rizzle Kicks bandmate Harvey Sylvester, Jordan will delve into personal experiences with ADHD, aiming to break down misconceptions about the condition.

name: Your Favorite Story
summary: Your Favorite Story is a syndicated TV anthology series.

name: Ayla y los Mirror
summary: Ayla, after losing her memory, rediscovers her passion for dancing with the help of The Mirrors.

name: 薄少别演了夫人看不见
Anatomy of Lies
summary:
Anatomy of Lies reveals the rise and fall of Grey's Anatomy star writer Elisabeth Finch, whose jaw-dropping lies fooled Hollywood for years, and became fodder for many high-profile episodes of Grey's. The story is told by some of her closest contacts, many speaking for the first time. 

Originally reported in the Vanity Fair article "Scene Stealer," the docuseries reveals how Finch, a master of manipulation, saved her best fiction for her own life story and exploited the empathy of those around her. Her final mark was trauma survivor Jennifer Beyer, who entrusted Finch with her deepest secrets. But as Beyer uncovers the web of lies that deceived Hollywood for years, she faces a daunting challenge: can she reclaim the narrative from a convincing storyteller who showed no signs of stopping?

name: Wolf King
summary: Wolf King set in a world where mortal man is ruled over by the Werelords, we will meet a 16-year-old shepherd boy Drew Ferran, a teen whose life is changed forever when he discovers he's the last surviving Wolf King.

name: Disaster Date
summary: With friends like these, who needs enemies? Using hidden cameras, Disaster Dates are recorded in all their glory. They are set up by one friend who sends another buddy on a blind date, but what the dater doesn't know is that they are really being paired with an actor who is armed with personal information about their date to make them as uncomfortable as possible. Humiliation pays, however, because for every minute the date lasts, up to an hour, the dater earns a dollar.

name: Growing Home with Jamie Durie
summary:
The Seven Network is pleased to announce the return of Jamie Durie in an inspiring new documentary series following his family's journey as they navigate the turbulent and challenging task of building a new eco home.

Coming soon to Channel 7 and 7plus, Growing Home with Jamie Durie features Durie, his partner Ameka and children – three-year-old daughter Beau and 18-month-old son Nash – as they build their dream home with off-grid capability in Sydney's beautiful Northern Beaches. 

Filmed across the two-year build, the series brings viewers a fresh combination of stunning architecture, energy and cost saving ideas, eco-innovation initiatives, home-building challenges, engineering feats, and garden extreme-scaping.

name: Dream Deals
summary: Dubai, the city of mega-deals and ruthless competition! Valeria, Sarah, Louisa, and Edwin, four German agents, are united by their dream of fast wealth as they battle for the most lucrative deals in the desert metropolis. Under constant pressure from their demanding boss, a relentless power struggle rages behind the scenes. They are willing to sacrifice it all to seal that one big deal.

name: Diary of an Island
summary: A calendar year in the life of the Holy Island of Lindisfarne, with contributions from the island's inhabitants.

name: Himitsu no Hanazono
summary: A 28-year old female magazine editor who is tired of work and feels she doesn't have a life is assigned to be in charge of a very popular cartoonist with a most lovely name, Yuriko Hanazono. But as she goes to Hanazono's residence/office, she is met by four men who seem to be her assistants. Then it turns out those four men are brothers who form a team named Yuriko Hanazono by taking roles to create popular comics. In this heartwarming comedy, the exhausted editor may find out the key to be happy while she is being driven crazy by this unique gang of brothers.

name: Jeremy Jones' Further
summary: Further explores some of the world's most remote mountain terrain while continuing Jones' mission to camp deep in the backcountry and on the summits of unridden lines to access nearly vertical spines and wide-open powder fields.

name: My Name Is Harry Worth
summary: A mild-mannered man who lives in a boarding house frequently finds himself in the most improbable situations due to a variety of mishaps and misunderstandings.

name: Polo
summary: This rousing docuseries goes behind the scenes of professional polo, offering an unprecedented look into the players' lives on and off the field.

name: Brennero
summary:
Bolzano, South Tyrol. Part of Italy, but here many speak German. It is a two-faced city, with citizens of German origin and those Italians, all equally shaken when a ruthless serial killer returns.

Eva Kofler and Paolo Costa, Public Prosecutor and Inspector of different languages and cultures, hunt down a ruthless murderer who has returned to strike after years, reopening old wounds.

name: Nisha Katona's Home Kitchen
summary: Nisha will prepare some of her favourite recipes at her home using ingredients from local suppliers and her own garden. She shares her home with family, their three dogs, four horses, four goats and assorted ducks, chickens, guinea fowl and alpacas, and viewers will be immersed in the laughter, visits from friends (some furry) as Nisha shares recipes for simple but delicious dishes.

name: The Royal Beat with Kate Thornton
summary: The exclusive royal talk show will feature various royal expert guests - from royal newspaper editors to former Palace insiders where together they will discuss all of the recent news surrounding the royal family. Each episode will bring fresh, knowledgeable and detailed insight into the monarchy in the UK and abroad.

name: Ghosts Australia
summary:
New lovebirds Kate and Sean are about to jump into the hellscape that is the inner-city rental market, until Kate inherits a huge mansion in the country. Moving in together for the first time the young couple are attempting domestic bliss, but unbeknown to them, the house is haunted by a collection of needy spirits who carked it in Ramshead Manor over the past 200 years.

Optimistic go-getter Kate wants to revamp the manor into a boutique hotel, but loveable city boy Sean isn't so sure, he isn't built for country living. When a near-death experience gives Kate the power to see the ghosts, all their lives (and afterlives) will change forever.

As Kate and Sean navigate the milestones of a new relationship, building a business and dealing with the emotional needs of six neurotic ghosts, will their relationship survive or end up as dead as their new housemates?

name: AA Insurance Location Location Location NZ
summary: The worldwide smash-hit series returns to New Zealand! Trusted property experts, Jayne Kiely and Paul Glover help house hunting Kiwi navigate the real estate market and match them with their dream home!

name: Well Anyway
summary: John Dally lives alone in a scruffy little flat in Earls Court. He scrapes a living by doing bits of photography, bits of detective work ... bits of anything really. His world is about to change when John Chance, a would-be international jet-setting conman, rings his doorbell and uses his charm and deception to persuade Dally to let him share his flat.

name: Super Happy Magic Forest
summary: Super Happy Magic Forest is a comedy quest adventure series featuring five heroes, led by the outgoing and courageous fawn, Hoofius. Together they battle villains, share journeys, and have a jolly good time along the way, mainly involving a lot of picnics and of course, frolicking!

name: Smoggie Queens
summary:
Smoggie Queens is an out and out comedy centred around a gang of friends who are fiercely proud of their North Eastern town of Middlesbrough and their small pocket of the LGBTQ+ community.

Smoggie Queens tells the story of volatile Dickie along with drag queen Mam, self-styled hun Lucinda, awkward Sal and newcomer Stewart as they navigate love, life and their pride for a town that feels neglected in its own little corner of the UK. It's an underdog story on two fronts, so expect a few passionate scraps that may send your wig flying!

name: Into the Jungle with Ed Stafford
summary: Former British Army captain Ed Stafford invites dads and their children into his wilderness adventure school, helping struggling modern families by stripping them of all the distractions of the 21st century and putting them through some of the toughest outdoor experiences.

name: Maggie Winters
summary: Voted Most Likely to Succeed in high school, Maggie Winters thought she could do anything- until her marriage failed and career went nowhere. To regain her confidence, she decides to return to her hometown to get support from old friends.

name: Sjukan
summary: In the Hospital's department for undetermined stomach and heart diseases, there are three patients who seem to be enjoying themselves rudely, miscellaneous worker Bert Hersby, Östermalm resident Rutger Ahlenius and mother pig Patrik Larsson. They are cared for with a firm hand by the slightly distracted Dr. Söderberg and nurse Nader, who insists on calling all patients "Svenne".

name: New Puss in Boots
summary: In these vlog-style short webisodes, the swashbuckling feline hero Puss in Boots offers everyday advice to his legions of fans.

name: New Shrek
summary: The most lovable grump in the kingdom of Far Far Away, Shrek shares his opinions and gripes and all things ogre.

name: Swamp Talk with Shrek & Donkey
summary: The titular Shrek and his dashing cohost Donkey go on rants about pop culture and showcase funny skits for the audience.

previousepisode.name: Is This Shrek Or A Flower

name: Connections with James Burke
summary: A mind-blowing romp through history builds a pathway to the present – and a breakthrough that stands to profoundly change our future.

name: West End Murders
summary: West End Murders is the story of three murdered women: their lives, their deaths and two failed police investigations. Following former Met Police DCI Colin Sutton and his team, this investigation examines the historic cold case of the ‘Bunny Girl' murders, uncovering a key link between the murders of Eve Stratford, Lynda Farrow and the seemingly unconnected case of murdered schoolgirl Lynne Weedon, revealing the pattern of a potential serial killer gone unnoticed for decades in the process. With this new revelation, can Sutton and his team finally bring justice and close the book on a 40-year-old case once and for all?

name: Turmschatten
summary: The adopted daughter of Holocaust survivor Ephraim Zamir falls victim to a brutal attack by neo-Nazis. Zamir then makes a drastic decision: he takes the two perpetrators under his control and broadcasts the following events online. From now on he lets the community vote on the life and death of the men.

name: The Two Ronnies Spectacle
summary:
The Two Ronnies Spectacle aims to give comedy-lovers a charming insight into one of Britain's most interesting and well-loved double acts - The Two Ronnies. It will include rarely seen footage of the duo.

The series will delve deep into some of the exciting spectacles from The Two Ronnies, featuring an exclusive interview with Ronnie Corbett himself. Ronnie will also visit the Victoria & Albert Museum to unearth stored personal memorabilia of Ronnie Barker - artefacts that have not been seen on TV before.

Each show will contain numerous classic sketches from their BBC primetime series, alongside rare material from the UK and abroad. As well as in-depth and revealing interviews with friends and colleagues.

name: General Order
summary: Su Ke, a member of the archaeology club, accidentally time-travels to the era of Wu Guo when she touches the General Order. She gets caught up in a murder investigation led by General Dai Yu and is forced to marry him because her face resembles that of the victim. In her quest for the truth alongside Dai Yu, Su Ke discovers several of her clubmates who are also trapped in that era, including Sun Duo, who is now an emperor. With Sun Duo's help, they manage to capture the real murderer, but a bigger secret is still waiting to be uncovered.

name: The Best Man
summary: Chen Zhuo, heir to the Chen family, becomes a security guard at Xu Meiying's company to uncover the truth about his mother's death but unexpectedly ends up as her live-in son-in-law. Meanwhile, his twin brother, Chen Yue, impersonates him to stay close to Meiying and claim the inheritance. Battling family pressure, Chen Zhuo exposes Chen Yue's deceit, restores order, and chooses to share his life with Xu Meiying.

name: National Treasures
summary: Explore NZ's recent history - the wonderful, the hidden and the controversial. Join Scotty and Stacey Morrison, as they showcase unique historical objects and their personal stories. Made with the support of NZ On Air and Te Māngai Pāho.

name: Flash Belle Fridays
summary: To get viewers ready for a new season of "Belle Collective," OWN is introducing "Flash Belle Fridays," a special companion series. Executive producer and creator Carlos King will sit down for some Southern kiki with OG Belle Dr. Antoinette Liles and the newest member of the Collective, Selena. Every Friday leading up to the new season premiere, the trio flashes back to seminal past episodes of the series to reminisce, share behind-the-scenes stories, and reveal a few surprises. The drinks will also be flowing as Selena, a skilled bartender, crafts a new specialty drink each week.

name: To Catch a Smuggler: Tropical Takedown
summary: Air and Marine Operations and Homeland Security Investigations work throughout the Caribbean to combat the global cocaine trade. The "Caribbean Corridor" has become a gateway for criminal networks pushing cocaine to the U.S. and Europe. AMO and HSI agents seize millions in cocaine from smugglers and dismantle drug trafficking organizations operating in Puerto Rico and surrounding islands.

name: Northwoods Survival
summary: Northwoods Survival follows a diverse group of young Canadians as they embark on a challenging four-season mission: to build a life in the vast and unforgiving Canadian wilderness. The series takes viewers on an adventure through some of the country's most remote and rugged landscapes as these aspiring homesteaders face the harsh realities of living off the land and strive to not just survive but to thrive in these wild places, they now call home.

name: Dating Horror Stories
summary: Dating Horror Stories is a fresh digital sketch show from Comedy Central UK, blending humour with social commentary on modern dating. Fronted by rising comedic star Kyrah Gray, each episode revolves around the experiences of a single Black woman and the stereotypes and anxieties associated with dating in the 21st-century. Celebrity Cameos include Munya Chawawa, Kiell Smith-Bynoe and Ola Labib.

name: Zorro
summary: In Zorro, a young Latinx woman discovers that her long-deceased father was the legendary hero Zorro. She takes on his masked persona to defend the desperate citizens of her Austin, Texas community from the wealthy forces seeking to exploit them.

name: Лиса
summary: As a result of an accident, forensic expert Vera Lisitsyna gains mental vision, which allows her to see lies. The new ability greatly helps in investigating complex crimes, but adds problems in her personal life and communication with colleagues.

name: Beter wordt het niet
summary: David moves to Berlin to live with his girlfriend, but she dumps him immediately. Unwilling to give up on his hyper-romantic expectations about friendship, love and paying rent, he decides to stay. Things don't go as planned.

previousepisode.name: Ten Days For A Shirt Tail

name: Intimate
summary: A weekly interview made by Raf Reshef

name: Новые мистические истории
summary: A series of documentaries, each of which tells of a strange and mysterious chain of events. Unusual love stories and family secrets, strange dreams and minor events that change a person's life. Alexander Rapoport will give his commentary on the events and his personal vision of what is happening.

name: Courtois, the Return of the Number 1
summary: A portrait that shows the spectacular work of Thibaut Courtois to reach the decisive stretch of the season after the serious injury suffered just before the start of LaLiga. We will experience the uncertainty of undergoing surgery, the sacrifice he made to get back to his best, his day-to-day life with Mishel, his children and family, his intense schedule and other previously unknown facets.

name: Thalaivettiyaan Paalayam
summary: City-bred graduate Siddarth reluctantly takes on the role of Panchayat secretary in the quirky village of Thalaivettiyaan Paalayam, where he faces a series of humorous challenges as he struggles to adapt to his new rural life and not-so-cool job.

name: Baby Assassins Everyday!
summary: The continued (mis)adventures of teenage assassin duo Chisato Sugimoto and Mahiro Fukagawa.

previousepisode.name: Let's Talk About the Future Together

name: Een van ons
summary: Inspired by a true crime that gripped a whole nation for more than a decade. In the spring of 1999, the body of a 16-year-old girl was found on the outskirts of a small village in The Netherlands, next to an asylum seekers' center. ‘Een van ons' depicts how the long and frustrating search for the perpetrator confronted the inhabitants and asylum seekers of this little Dutch town with xenophobia, racism, and bizarre and persistent conspiracy theories, fueled by social media. The crime remained unsolved for more than 12 years, until an unprecedented use of a large-scale DNA investigation finally solved the case.

name: Ilha da Tentação: Brasil
summary: Flávia Alessandra and Otaviano Costa welcome four couples who decide to test the limits of their relationships on a paradise island in Mexico. In separate Villas – each filled with seductive Singles – they will live the most electrifying experience of their lives. Will these relationships resist temptations?

name: Ishq in the Air
summary: A chance encounter collides the fates of Naman and Kavya on a flight propelling them on an unforeseen journey of love. But as time unfolds, will they surpass the turbulent complexities of their contrasting worlds and backgrounds to embrace the love that's in the air?

name: The Mystery of Moksha Island
summary: In the heart of the Nicobar Islands lies Moksha, a private island created by Dr. Viswak Sen as a reflection of his inner world. When a group of visitors arrive for a tour, they encounter a series of unexplained deaths and tragedies, leaving them wondering: is this a tour or a trap?

name: Павел. Первый и последний
summary: A cruel tyrant or a seer on the throne? I call the drama about the most mysterious Russian emperor Paul a tyrant and even a madman, but his character and history are much deeper than the mask that his descendants have unfairly given him. The alienation of his mother's murder, the rejection of the court and the endless attempts to analyze who and why his father really was, formed a deeply tragic personality. Having become emperor after many years of waiting, Paul sought to get rid of the permissiveness of the nobility and improve the lives of serfs and ordinary soldiers. How will he be able to realize his plans and retain power?

name: Ingebrigtsen - Born to Run
summary: The Ingebrigtsen brothers are back in a dramatic season. Without a coach, the brothers must support each other while their father Gjert is under investigation. Jakob is expecting a child and faces injury issues. Henrik juggle

name: Let There Be Love
summary: Timothy Love is a confirmed bachelor but when he meets Judy he is willing to give up his individualism for her - and her 3 children ... and dog.

name: The Contract
summary: A British spy helps a Russian scientist to defect from the Soviet Union by taking a perilous journey through the Eastern Bloc.

name: Vuelve a mí
summary: Nuria García works in a factory owned by the Zepeda Group to support her sister and her son. She maintains a relationship with Braulio and feels that everything is fine in her life, but her world takes a sudden nosedive when her child is kidnapped. When Andrés tries to escape from his kidnappers, he suffers an accident that leaves him without memories and ends up in an orphanage. Amelia, Braulio's wife, adopts him and soon after faces a crossroads when she discovers that the child is not an orphan. Nuria never stops looking for her son and arrives in Mexico City, where she meets Santiago, the man who will help her find the answers she seeks while he himself seeks to vindicate his tarnished reputation. Together, they must overcome obstacles and find redemption in the face of adversity.

name: Hasta que la plata nos separe
summary:
Rafael Méndez is a prolific seller of all kinds of household products. Alejandra Maldonado is the successful Commercial Manager of Ramenautos. She is a woman of aristocratic origin, while Méndez is of peasant origin.

Méndez is in a relationship with Vicky Pardo, a sensual and jealous neighbor. Alejandra is about to marry Luciano Valenzuela, her prince charming.

One fine day, fate crosses Alejandra with Méndez in a fatal accident and, from then on, their lives and those of the people close to them will never be the same again. Méndez will have to do everything possible to settle the debt with which he has left Alejandra after the accident and this closeness will lead them to fall in love despite the social differences. However, circumstances and their respective families and partners will do everything possible so that the love that has arisen between them cannot come true, making them enemies again, leaving Alejandra in poverty and Méndez in wealth.

name: Hasta que la plata nos separe
summary: Alejandra Maldonado and Rafael Méndez come from opposing worlds and star in an unconventional romance.

name: Missing, Presumed Dead
summary: Missing, Presumed Dead is a true crime series that tells the stories of real-life disappearances and rediscoveries from the perspective of the missing people, their loved ones, and the investigators.

name: Small Town, Big Riot
summary: Mobeen Azhar investigates how a protest outside an asylum seeker hotel in Merseyside in 2023 turned into a riot, uncovering a blueprint for a national wave of violence.

name: Our Tiny Islands
summary: From exceptional enclaves and secluded sanctuaries to awe-inspiring archipelagos and hidden havens, what is it like to live on one of the UK's 6000 teeny-tiny islands?

name: The Assassin
summary: Ning Jin Hai is an assassin from Bai Yu Jing - a place where homeless women gather and train to become female assassins. These assassins are then dispatched under the name of "Yin Niang."

name: Field of Vampires
summary: With exclusive access to unprecedent archeological discoveries, Field of Vampires travels throughout Eastern, Central and Western Europe and the US to understand how the myth of vampires began, unlock the secrets of the extraordinary ritual burials of those suspected of vampiric behaviour, and explore why some dead people were singled out as being vampires.

name: Gimlet Eyes
summary: Guo Cong, Chief of the Travel Inspection Division at Huayan Airport Customs in Binhai, leads officers Zhang Yu, Lü Xiaoyan, Yan Bowen, and others in holding the frontline of national security. Within the fifty-meter stretch of the customs clearance channel, they see through deception, intercept smugglers, and crack down on a series of complex cases—from illegal gene sample trafficking and drug-concealed carpets to the smuggling of precious artworks, HPV vaccines, luxury watches, antiques, and psychotropic drugs. Through relentless efforts, they overcome daunting challenges, uncover the masterminds behind the smuggling rings, and safeguard the nation's interests. These young customs officers, in this process, gain invaluable experience and forge unbreakable bonds in the line of duty.

name: Yummy Yummy Yummy
summary: The story follows the Shen family, who accidentally arrive in Yong'an City and encounter Lin Yan, a royal official. This chance meeting leads them on an extraordinary journey filled with culinary delights, local traditions, and an unconventional love story. But what twists and turns await them in this remarkable adventure?

name: Those Days
summary: Mingzhu, whose family life was happy and love sweet, had just registered her marriage and discovered she was pregnant, when her husband Jianqi tragically died while performing a heroic act. Amidst the swirling opinions of others, Mingzhu made her own firm decision to keep the child, only to be confronted by the arrival of her long-lost biological parents. Through the bittersweet reconnection with her family, she gradually overcame her grief. But when her father-in-law unexpectedly passed away, it revealed that her in-laws' family was deeply in debt. Stepping up with courage, Mingzhu sorted out the debts, took over the business, and united her family like never before, rebuilding their lives with renewed vigor.

name: Pedro El Escamoso: Más Escamoso que Nunca
summary: Pedro returns to Colombia to rebuild his relationship with his son, but it won't be an easy task.

name: The Fishbowl
summary: The Fishbowl is a procedural about a brilliant medical examiner overseeing a private room at the Manhattan morgue that investigates New York City's weirdest deaths.

name: For the People
summary: A liberal-minded chief deputy district attorney in the Los Angeles D.A.'s office finds her professional world profoundly shifted when a conservative district attorney becomes her new boss.

name: Фиктивный брак
summary: Active and purposeful Lida is studying for a master's degree and works in a Fashion house in St. Petersburg. Her parents own a small weaving factory, and Lida is obsessed with taking the family business to a new level. For the sake of an internship abroad, she is ready to fulfill the condition of the host party in a few days — to be married. With the help of a friend, she quickly finds a man who agrees to arrange a fictitious marriage. Suddenly, Lida's father goes to the hospital with a heart attack, she has to cancel her internship and head the factory. On a business trip, she meets Igor. A stormy romance breaks out between them, which is quickly followed by a marriage proposal. Now Lida urgently needs to find her fictitious husband and get a divorce. But he went on a geological expedition. Lida goes in search of him…

name: Падающая звезда
summary: The year is 1968. Crimea. The corpse of a twenty-year-old Muscovite woman who fell off the rocks was found by the sea. The deceased girl came with her friends to relax "savages" on the coast. The investigation will have to find out if it was an accident or if it was all the fault of a difficult relationship within the company.

name: Esquenta!
summary: A mix of Brazilian popular music plus interviews with the most prominent artists in the Brazilian scene.

name: No Appointment Necessary
summary: Alf Butler is a greengrocer and after buying a hairdressing salon he employs a professional manager to run it - but she runs it rather too well.

name: Roger Doesn't Live Here Anymore
summary: Roger's acrimonious divorce is not helped when his new lover marries an all-in wrestler.

name: My Honourable Mrs
summary: Having indulged his wife's interest in Parliament for many years, Henry Prendergast has to take her more seriously now she's an MP.

name: As Good Cooks Go
summary: A travelling cook turns a run down transport cafe into a fashionable restaurant.

name: Betrayal
summary: John Hughes joined MI5 during the war on terror and was at the forefront of averting the biggest terrorist plots on UK soil. Now in his mid 40s and married with two children he's struggling to adapt to the new MI5, where threats to national security have changed and he's forced to adapt to the values of a progressive work environment.

name: Projekt UFO
summary: An alleged UFO landing in Truskasy, Warmia, spurs a group's quest of self-discovery and inquiry into the origins of the extraterrestrial.

name: A Recipe for Murder
summary: The SkyShowtime Original A Recipe for Murder is a compelling documentary series that chronicles the violent death of Colombian surgeon Edwin Arrieta on a tranquil Thai island, at the hands of Daniel Sancho, a 29-year-old aspiring chef known for his YouTube videos. Sancho, the son of one of Spain's most well-known actors, Rodolfo Sancho, was tried and convicted to life imprisonment in a Thai court earlier this summer. In spite of the trial being covered extensively by the world's media, mysteries remain about the nature of the relationship between Arrieta and Sancho. The five-part series explores the truth behind not only their relationship but also the double life led by each man. While examining a toxic relationship, the shocking discovery of a dismembered body, and the investigation that followed, renowned documentary filmmaker Jose Gomez shines a light on the role of the Thai legal system, the media, and even the audience itself.

name: The Four Just Men
summary: Action-adventure series based on the novel by Edgar Wallace about four international characters who team up to fight injustice.

name: But Seriously, It's Sheila Hancock
summary: Variations on a theme in the form of poetry, comedy sketches, songs and discussion.

name: Gadebetjentene
summary: We get close to the downtown police patrol in their daily work to create safety and security on the streets of Copenhagen.

name: Classic Car Kings
summary: The team at Irv's Resto Shop in Barrow-in-Furness, Cumbria, are world renowned for their work rescuing classic cars that appear to be beyond repair. Big character, Paul "Irv" Irving, and his three sons love taking on the most ambitious, challenging jobs. Their crew of welders, fabricators, blasters, painters and mechanics have the knowledge, skills and the passion to bring vehicles not just back from the brink, but onto the concourse. These classic car kings are restoration royalty.

name: Football Fantastics
summary: Football Fantastics is packed with big personalities, toe-tapping songs, laugh-out-loud moments, and plenty of heart. Whether you're mad about football or just love a great story, this is a series that scores every time.

name: Go Get Arty
summary: Go Get Arty is here! Hang out with the super creative family, the Kwapongs, and their hilarious sidekick, Bristles the talking paintbrush.

name: The Entertainment Mix
summary: Michelle McManus serves up big-name interviews, features and the latest in entertainment and culture news from across Scotland.

name: The Guest
summary:
Ria has never had the time or opportunity to think about what she might actually want from the world. So, when she starts cleaning for Fran, she's intoxicated by this confident and self-assured woman who encourages her to take control of her life and, when Ria flourishes, an intense friendship is forged.

However, when Fran's advice leads to a shocking event, the lives of these two very different women become intertwined by shared secrets and dangerous plots. What follows is a compelling and manipulative game of cat-and-mouse. But just who is playing who?

name: Rasaí Lios Tuathail
summary: Coverage of horse racing.

name: Law of the Plainsman
summary: An Apache Indian becomes a Deputy U.S. Marshal.

name: Making News
summary: Making News is a British television drama set in the world of journalism.

name: A Bite to Eat with Alice
summary:
Hosted by cook, author, columnist, radio presenter and News Breakfast foodie, Alice Zaslavsky, A Bite To Eat with Alice will focus on recipes that are simple and fresh, built around accessible and affordable ingredients that can be prepared at home to inspire Australian audiences to feel more confident in the kitchen.

Alice will kickstart each episode with a recipe inspired by her special guest. Then her guest arrives, bringing in one of their favourite ingredients for Alice to turn into something delicious, showing those at home how easy it is to get dinner on the table with ingredients on hand. Finally, Alice faces a challenge to change the guest's mind about an ingredient they don't enjoy or are unsure how to cook, or to help them with a food-related issue.

name: Seal le Dáithí
summary: Dáithí Ó Sé hosts his weekly chat show 'Seal le Dáithí' on TG4. Each week Dáithí will chat one-to-one with a different guest where they will share their life story and experiences.

name: The Girl Inside Me
summary: Xiaoxiao, a soul harried by marriage pressures, unexpectedly traverses time and ends up in the body of an ancient man, embarking on a joyous journey where she cohabits a body with Chu Xiaoran, an ancient bathhouse attendant. Armed with a magical pouch that produces any modern item at will, Xiaoxiao helps Chu Xiaoran win over the aloof princess. Meanwhile, she takes advantage of inhabiting Chu Xiaoran's body to flirt outrageously with the handsome and attractive men of the era.

name: Koori Knockout Live
summary: It's on again! The Koori Knockout draw is back! Catch All the Key match ups from the biggest weekend the Indigenous Calendar. LIVE Bathurst on Wiradjuri Country.

name: Bamay
summary: A showcase of Australia's most diverse and stunning landscapes, shot from the air and inspired by the word Bamay, which means land in the Bundjalung language from northern New South Wales.

name: Cycling: NRS Tour of Gippsland
summary: Cycling Highlights, NRS 2024, Tour of Gippsland.

name: Los 43 de Ayotzinapa: Un Crimen de Estado
summary: HBO documentary series that recounts through protagonists and an exhaustive journalistic investigation, all the key elements of the case of forced disappearance of the 43 students from Ayotzinapa, Mexico, on September 26, 2014.

name: Destinations of the Damned with Zak Bagans
summary:
Zak Bagans sends documentary crews to capture true tales of twisted terror, local lore and deeply disturbing paranormal activity at doomed locations across the globe.

Viewers are transported on a mysterious journey where haunts and horrors reign at every destination. These are the world's darkest and most evil locations. Driven by the macabre history and hair-raising unexplained activity that surrounds each nefarious site, Bagans sends his documentary film crew around the globe to explore what lurks within.

name: Castle Secrets
summary: Around the globe, imposing structures stand tall against time. As the world moves forward, they remain silent sentinels; guardians of ancient lives lived, mysteries, and secret. But now, they will be silent no more.

previousepisode.name: Escape from Colditz, Art Asylum, Death not Dishonour

name: Australia's Wild Moments
summary: Australia's Wild Moments explores how the forces of nature, human impact and a warming climate have shaped and challenged the continent's natural world.

name: Loving Gluten Free
summary: When Chef Helen Tzouganatos is diagnosed with coeliac disease at 32-years-old, she showcases how to live everyday gluten free and still eat delicious food.

name: Beloved
summary: At the turn of the century, due to the reservoir requirements of a water conservancy project, a small riverside town was about to be submerged. The construction of a new city and the relocation of its residents were in full swing. In the summer of 2002, torrential rains poured down on Dongjiang City. A bizarre murder case caught the attention of the police: a dead lover, a husband who disappeared and then reappeared—both "killer" and "victim." Through the police's relentless investigation, a long-buried past was finally unearthed. The complexities of human nature had blinded many, but the truth can never be drowned—wherever the eye falls, there is sunlight.

name: El Man es Germán
summary: After a journey through the United States, Germán returns to recover Jasbleidy and the tiger, his son.

name: La hija del mariachi
summary: A singer falls in love with a young Mexican who arrives in Bogotá fleeing from justice for a crime he did not commit.

name: Qué bonito amor
summary: Emiliano Martínez de los Garzas y Treviño will discover love and what it means to be Mexican thanks to María, a singer he meets while fleeing from the betrayal of his friends.

name: Rugbaí Beo
summary: Rugby coverage in Irish.

name: Moving West
summary: Shot against the back drop of the unique natural beauty and culture of the West of Ireland, over the course of six half hour episodes we follow the lives of families and individuals who have moved or are in the process of moving to the west of Ireland. From various parts of Ireland and from more far flung places such as Australia, Texas and Austria, presenter Mary Kennedy meets the people in their new homes and explores the reasons why they made the decision to make a major life change and "Move West".

name: Is Mise le Mess
summary: In this brand new series, three cleaning fanatics are going to rid the country of dirt. We follow Derena, Síle and Colleen as they seek out mess and clutter. Who says cleaning can't be fun?
